description.name: Fell Foot Cottage
description.headline: Traditional stone cottage at the foot of the fells
description.description: A 19th-century stone cottage on the edge of the village, with low beams, a log burner and a small enclosed garden. Walkers and dog owners love the direct access to the fell paths.

reviews: Charming cottage, perfect base for walking. The log burner made the evenings special.
Lovely garden and our dog was very welcome. Kitchen a bit dated but had everything.
The cottage is cosy but the WiFi listing is misleading - there is no internet, and the water pressure upstairs was poor.
Good value, great walks from the door. Bring warm clothes, the heating struggles a little in winter.
